tool.name: Open PR with changes
tool.description: Commit the current workspace changes, push the branch, and open a GitHub pull request. Only meaningful in a workspace-backed run (Builder).

commitMessage.description: Commit message for the staged changes

draft.description: Open as a draft PR (default false)

parameters.command: git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet && echo 'nothing to commit' || git commit -m "$COMMIT_MSG")

parameters.args: {{ ({ owner: (lastOutputOf('normalize_input')||{}).owner, repo: (lastOutputOf('normalize_input')||{}).repo, title: (lastOutputOf('normalize_input')||{}).title, head: (lastOutputOf('normalize_input')||{}).branch, base: (lastOutputOf('normalize_input')||{}).base, body: (lastOutputOf('normalize_input')||{}).body, draft: (lastOutputOf('normalize_input')||{}).draft }) }}
